business_problem: InMobi’s backend data platform was processing about 2 PB of data per day with shared Spark infrastructure that created storage bottlenecks, poor workload isolation, and limited visibility into compute and storage costs.
solution_summary: InMobi uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: InMobi’s backend data platform was processing about 2 PB of data per day with shared Spark infrastructure that created storage bottlenecks, poor workload isolation, and limited visibility into compute and storage costs. Cloud Storage became the single source of truth for the bronze data layer and removed the I/O bottlenecks that constrained Spark throughput, serving as the storage layer. Google Kubernetes Engine runs workload-specific Spark node pools and redirects production compute to better-isolated clusters, serving as the orchestration layer. Storage Transfer Service migrates data movement into the new storage foundation during cutover, serving as the ingest layer. Bronze data is standardized in Cloud Storage, Storage Transfer Service helps shift data movement into the new architecture, and Spark workloads are redirected to workload-specific node pools on GKE so compute and storage scale independently.
